title: Divisor Census
statement: How many positive divisors does $360$ have?
hints: Write $360$ as a product of prime powers.
A divisor chooses an exponent for each prime independently.
solution: $360 = 2^3\cdot 3^2\cdot 5$. A divisor is $2^a3^b5^c$ with $0\le a\le 3$, $0\le b\le 2$, $0\le c\le 1$, so there are $4\cdot 3\cdot 2 = 24$ of them.
